comment: Drafted by Claude from the recorded data and the spec rules; every entry checked by hand. Reviewed and approved by the owner on 2026-11-03.

entries.name: It's a Long Way to the Top (If You Wanna Rock 'n' Roll)
entries.comment: "It's a Long Way to the Top (If You Wanna Rock 'N' Roll)" by AC/DC on "High Voltage". Walk-on tape credited to AC/DC: Metallica have no recording, so the original artist pass finds AC/DC's studio track on "High Voltage". "Rock 'n' Roll" vs Spotify's "Rock 'N' Roll" normalises equal.

entries.name: The Ecstasy of Gold
entries.comment: "The Ecstasy of Gold" by Ennio Morricone, Metallica on "We All Love Ennio Morricone". JUDGEMENT CALL: Tape credited to Ennio Morricone. The band pass finds Metallica's own studio recording of it (credited "Ennio Morricone, Metallica" on the tribute compilation "We All Love Ennio Morricone"), so per MATCH-2 it is Found (not a cover fallback) and the original Morricone recording is never searched for. Two copies exist; the earlier release date (2007-02-20) wins. The tape actually played is Morricone's original; the owner may prefer that, but that would need a spec change.

entries.name: Kirk and Rob Doodle
entries.comment: JUDGEMENT CALL: An improvised guitar/bass interlude ("doodle"), not a song. ENT-1 only skips solo, jam and improvisation, so it is a matchable entry and Not found, which counts against the score. FLAGGED: adding "doodle" to ENT-1 would need a spec change.
